status: Signature design proposals and current-source audit only. Not read by runtime spawners. No rarity ownership or new candidate placement implemented.
scope: Basic terrain outside special nexus ownership. Exclude player planting, shops, general chest loot and authored zones when judging ambient habitat exclusivity. Conditional shore/fishing and cave candidates are identified explicitly.

encounterRarity.thresholds: Qualitative design bands, not measured numeric thresholds. Static occupied-cell percentages, per-tile fauna counts, per-shore-metre seats and per-interaction loot probabilities have different denominators and cannot share an honest universal cutoff. Existing frequencies are stated where known; no numbers are changed by these labels.
encounterRarity.notItemQuality: Item rarity remains the existing seven-tier Basic/Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic/Legendary/Godly ladder. Creature combat tier is a third, separate scale.

statusLegend.existing_exclusive: Candidate already has an exclusive ordinary basic habitat or a stated exclusive context; the proposed encounter-frequency band is not automatically implemented.
statusLegend.shared: Candidate exists here or through an explicitly stated existing conditional lane, but also occurs elsewhere. This is a differentiation gap, not a completed exclusive slot.
statusLegend.gap: Candidate has existing art but no current ordinary placement in this terrain. Some proposals additionally need new interaction behavior or rewards; each states that work explicitly.

uniquenessRule: Each proposedThing.id is assigned at most once at each encounter level across all populated cards. Reuse at a different level is deliberate. This guarantees unique proposed assignments, not current runtime frequency exclusivity; shared candidates require a future distribution decision.
userConstraints: Deer only in forest and residential.
No ore in ordinary street rubble, and no crimson ore in forest.
Butterflies move out of forest into grass; other permitted butterfly habitats remain.
Corvid-like birds: seagulls on beach sand, crows in park, ravens in residential only. No pier gulls.
Only positively identified public piers can spawn; private or unknown-access piers stay empty.
Wetland has no rocks, ores or flowers.
Pitch has no basic rock spawns.
Orchard has no bats, rocks, butterflies or spiders; orchard content is limited to a 14 m inside boundary band.

residentialRockAudit.mechanism: LOT_ROCK_DRY suppresses independent residential yard rock clusters. Generic _street:true rocks line selected 25% of minor streets through spawnStreetRocksSteps, now plain rubble only: no street ore. They remain eligible basic frontage content outside wetlands; string-valued themed street dressing is different.
residentialRockAudit.measurementCorrection: The earlier fixture helper discarded every truthy _street record and therefore missed these existing residential rocks. Fix measurement classification; do not invent a replacement yard-rock spawner.

artAudit.method: Visually reviewed the standalone archive sprites and checked selected PNG SHA-256 values against shipped PNGs. The 34 selected proposal files are not byte-identical to shipped PNGs. Existing atlas crops or similar prop concepts may still exist; archived_unused describes the selected standalone file, not proven global visual uniqueness.
artAudit.selection: Keep each current candidate and its evidence visible. Every shared slot now has an art-backed interactive new-item alternative; the two gap candidates without earlier art/mechanics have alternatives too. The ten earlier art-backed gap proposals remain. Alternatives are proposals, not new runtime spawns. Wetland reeds already exist visually; the proposed harvestable clump is explicitly a mechanical variant.
artAudit.copyPolicy: Small selected art set copied into docs/proposal-art for reproducible proposal previews only; no runtime art registration, new placements or new mechanics are implemented.

alternativeRule: Each newItemAlternative.id is used once per encounter band. Show alongside the existing proposedThing and its audit status; never replace or imply the existing shared candidate is exclusive. Where a gap already has artProposal and interactionProposal, that existing proposal is the new item option. All 34 shared/gap slots therefore have a pictured interactive option.
